title: Reports (operations)
intro: The Reports hub lists operational and sales reports by category. Pick a category, choose a report, set filters, then run or export from the filter panel.

sections.title: Reports hub
steps: The left column lists report categories (Sales, Operations, Orders, etc.).
The middle column lists reports inside the selected category.
The right panel shows filters for the chosen report.
sections.caption: Reports hub three-column layout.

sections.title: Categories
sections.intro: Categories group related reports: dashboards, sales, orders, cash closing, operations, products, inventory, labor, and AI.
steps: Click a category to load its report list.
A check mark shows the active category.
Opening some reports may require manager PIN approval.
sections.caption: Report category list.

sections.title: Choose a report
steps: After selecting a category, pick a report name in the middle column.
The filter panel on the right updates for that report.
Common operational reports include Sales dashboard, Activity, Expense, and Cash closing.
sections.caption: Sub-report list and filter panel.
